meta.name: decision
meta.description: Make a product decision with full context from the vault and available sources

copy.tagline: 基于完整背景信息做出产品决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要综合多方信息来做出产品方向选择。
copy.tagline_en: Make product decisions with full context from vault and sources.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to make product decisions by synthesizing information from vault and sources.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 帮你做产品决策：搜索笔记、GitHub等资料，列出选项利弊，生成决策文档、沟通草稿和待办任务。
howto.when: 当你提出一个产品决策问题，例如“是否支持某功能”或“A与B哪个优先”时触发。

say.text: 帮我决定是否在下一个版本支持功能X。
say.note: 它会搜索相关笔记和GitHub讨论，给出选项分析。

say.text: 功能A和功能B，哪个应该优先开发？
say.note: 它会对比两个选项的利弊，并生成决策文档。

howto.what_en: Helps you make product decisions: searches notes, GitHub, etc., lists options with pros/cons, generates a decision note, communication draft, and follow-up tasks.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask a product decision question, e.g., 'should we support feature X' or 'prioritize A vs B'.

say_en.text: Help me decide whether to support feature X in the next release.
say_en.note: It will search notes and GitHub discussions, then present options.

say_en.text: Which should we prioritize: feature A or feature B?
say_en.note: It will compare both options and create a decision document.
